language.title: Apni bhasha chunein
language.body: Aap ise kabhi bhi Settings mein badal sakte hain.

phone.title: Aapka phone number
phone.body: Yeh pakka karne ke liye hum ek code bhejenge ki yeh aap hi hain.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.badCode: Yeh code sahi nahi hai. Kripya phir koshish karein.
phone.failed: Sign in nahi ho paya. Kripya phir koshish karein.
phone.localCode: Is app ke liye tay kiya gaya sign-in code daalein. Is setup mein text message nahi bheja jaata.

consent.title: Healix kya istemaal kar sakta hai?
consent.body: Jab tak aap na kahein, kuch bhi chalu nahi hoga. Aap ise kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.

triage.title: Mere lakshan samajhna
triage.body: Aap jo batate hain, Healix use padhkar sahi specialist suggest karta hai.

reports.title: Meri reports padhna
reports.body: Healix aapki jaanch reports padhkar unhein aasan shabdon mein samjhata hai.

location.title: Meri location istemaal karna
location.body: Sirf paas ke doctor dhundhne aur emergency mein istemaal hoti hai.

voice.title: Sunna aur bolna
voice.body: Aapki awaaz ko text mein badalne ke liye Sarvam AI ko bheji jaati hai, aur text bolkar sunaya jaata hai.

consent.needOne: Aage badhne ke liye kam se kam ek chalu karein.

profile.title: Yeh kiske liye hai?
profile.body: Apne phone se mata-pita ya parivar ke kisi sadasya ki dekhbhal sambhalne ke liye unhein jodein.
profile.name: Naam
profile.elder: Bade akshar aur saral screens istemaal karein

home.speakOrType: Apni bhasha mein boliye ya likhiye.
home.sosTitle: Emergency madad ke liye dabakar rakhein

triage.title: Bataiye aapko kaisa lag raha hai
triage.placeholder: Jo mehsoos ho raha hai use bataiye…
triage.checking: Pehle khatre ke sanket dekhe ja rahe hain…
triage.resultTitle: Iska kya matlab ho sakta hai
triage.errorTitle: Abhi yeh jaanch nahi ho payi

emergency.title: Abhi emergency madad lein
emergency.holdToShare: Location aur jaankari share karne ke liye dabakar rakhein
emergency.holdHint: 2 second dabakar rakhein. Hospital ko aapki location aur chhota saar milega.
emergency.sentBody: Unhein pata hai ki aap aa rahe hain. Pahunchne mein lagbhag {{minutes}} min lagenge.
emergency.failed: Bhej nahi paye. Kripya abhi 102 par call karein.
emergency.usingSaved: Location band hai, isliye aapka saved ilaaka istemaal hua.
emergency.publicNote: Aap sign in nahi hain, isliye yahan sirf call aur sabse paas ka hospital dikhta hai.
emergency.signIn: Apne vivaran ke saath hospital ko soochit karne ke liye sign in karein
emergency.locating: Sabse paas ka emergency department khoja ja raha hai…
emergency.noLocation: Sabse paas ka emergency department dekhne ke liye apni location ki ijazat dein.

doctors.title: Aapke paas ke doctor
doctors.empty: In filters se koi doctor nahi mila
doctors.emptyHint: Doori ya fees ki seema badhakar dekhein.
doctors.errorTitle: Abhi doctors ki list nahi mil payi

bestTime.title: Milne ka sabse achha time
bestTime.note: Pichhli visits ke aadhar par is doctor ka aam wait.
bestTime.none: Aaj isse shaant koi time nahi.

form.title: Booking ka vivaran
form.intro: Batayein aapko kya chahiye, phir apne paas ke doctors mein se chunein.

booking.title: Time chunein
booking.noSlots: Is din koi khali time nahi bacha.
booking.taken: Abhi-abhi bhar gaya. Agla khali time: {{time}}
booking.failed: Abhi book nahi ho paya. Kripya phir koshish karein.
booking.tokenFailed: Aapka time book ho gaya, par token abhi nahi mil paya.
booking.noneLeft: Is doctor ke paas koi khali time nahi hai.
booking.notExactWindow: Aapke pasandida samay mein koi slot khali nahi tha, isliye us din ka sabse nazdeeki samay diya gaya hai.
booking.notExactDate: Aapki chuni tareekh par kuch khali nahi tha, isliye agla khali samay diya gaya hai.

token.noTokenBody: Token aur ghar se nikalne ka time pane ke liye doctor book karein.
token.delayLonger: Ab yeh pehle se lagbhag {{minutes}} min zyada hai.
token.delayShorter: Ab yeh pehle se lagbhag {{minutes}} min kam hai.
token.called: Aapki baari hai. Kripya {{room}} mein jayein.
token.spoken: Ghar se {{minutes}} min mein nikalein, {{time}} tak. Aapka token {{label}} hai.
token.spokenNow: Abhi nikalne ka time hai. Aapka token {{label}} hai.
token.loading: Aapka token load ho raha hai…
token.error: Yeh token load nahi ho paya.

swap.ask: Aage wale se jagah badalne ko kahein
swap.title: Jagah badlein
swap.body: Apne se aage ka koi token chunein. Unhein sirf aapka token number dikhta hai, aapka naam nahi.
swap.defaultMessage: Kya hum jagah badal sakte hain, kripya?
swap.accepted: {{label}} maan gaye. Aapne jagah badal li.
swap.declined: {{label}} ne mana kar diya. Aap kisi aur se poochh sakte hain.
swap.expired: 5 minute tak koi jawab nahi aaya.
swap.limit: Is token ki sabhi {{max}} requests istemaal ho chuki hain.
swap.waitFirst: Pehle maujooda request ke jawab ka intezaar karein.
swap.nobody: Aapse aage koi wait mein nahi hai.
swap.calledBlock: Aapka token bula liya gaya hai.
swap.incomingTitle: Aapke peechhe wala jagah badalna chahta hai
swap.incomingBody: Token {{from}} aapki jagah lena chahta hai. Aap {{to}} par chale jayenge.
swap.failed: Request nahi bheji ja saki. Kripya phir koshish karein.
swap.respondFailed: Aapka jawab nahi bheja ja saka. Kripya phir koshish karein.

list.title: Meri reports
list.loading: Aapki reports load ho rahi hain…
list.error: Abhi aapki reports nahi mil payi.
list.emptyHint: Lab report upload karein, Healix use aasan shabdon mein samjhayega.

upload.title: Report upload karein
upload.body: Saaf photo lein ya koi report chunein. Healix use padhta hai, aur kuch samjhane se pehle aap dekhte hain ki kya mila.
upload.consent: Report samjhane ke liye Healix ko aapki lab report padhni hogi. Aapki ijazat tak kuch nahi padha jayega.
upload.allow: Meri reports padhne ki ijazat dein
upload.consentFailed: Aapki pasand save nahi ho payi. Kripya phir koshish karein.
upload.reading: Aapki report padhi ja rahi hai…
upload.failed: Yeh report padhi nahi ja saki. Saaf aur roshni wali photo aksar madad karti hai. Kripya phir koshish karein.
upload.badType: Kripya photo, PDF, Word file ya text file chunein.
upload.tooBig: Yeh file bahut badi hai. Kripya 50 MB se chhoti file chunein.
upload.formats: Photo, PDF, Word aur text files, 50 MB tak.
upload.privacy: Aapki report sirf aapko samjhane ke liye istemaal hoti hai. Aap use kabhi bhi hata sakte hain.
upload.failedUnreadable: Hum yeh file khol nahi paye. Kripya photo, PDF, Word ya text file chunein.
upload.failedNoText: Hamein padhne layak koi likhawat nahi mili. Saaf, roshni wali photo aksar madad karti hai.
upload.failedScanned: Yeh PDF ek scan hai aur padhi nahi ja saki. Kripya pannon ki saaf photo ya screenshot upload karein.

review.title: Values jaanchein
review.body: Healix ne yeh values aapki report se padhi hain. Samjhane se pehle jo galat lage use theek karein.
review.confirmFailed: Values pakki nahi ho payin. Kripya phir koshish karein.
review.notReady: Yeh report abhi padhi ja rahi hai. Kripya thodi der mein aayein.
review.imageFailed: Report ki tasveer load nahi ho payi.
review.noValues: Healix ko is document mein saamanya lab values nahi mili, isliye yahan jaanchne ko kuch nahi hai. Yeh jaisa hai waisa save hai, aur aap Healix AI se iske baare mein poochh sakte hain.
review.docPreview: Is tarah ki file yahan dikhayi nahi ja sakti, par ise padh liya gaya hai.

explain.loading: Aapki vyakhya taiyaar ho rahi hai…
explain.reviewFirst: Healix report tabhi samjhata hai jab aap uski values pakki kar lein.
explain.error: Yeh vyakhya load nahi ho payi.
explain.duplicate: Yeh jaanch aapne {{days}} din pehle karayi thi. Apne doctor se poochhein ki ise dohrana zaroori hai ya nahi.
explain.askAssistant: Is report ke kisi shabd ke baare mein Healix AI se poochhein

assistant.title: Healix AI
assistant.intro: Main aapki report aasan bhasha mein samjhata hoon aur rozmarra ke health sawaalon ke jawab deta hoon. Main diagnosis ya dawa nahi bata sakta.

starters.summary: Meri report aasan shabdon mein samjhao

assistant.placeholder: Apni report ya kisi health shabd ke baare mein poochhein
assistant.thinking: Aapki report dekhi ja rahi hai…
assistant.failed: Abhi jawab nahi mil paya. Kripya phir koshish karein.
assistant.viaGroq: Groq ki madad se diya gaya jawab

settings.title: Settings
settings.elderHint: Bade akshar, saral home screen aur awaaz chalu hone par nateeje padhkar sunaye jaate hain.
settings.consentTitle: Healix kya istemaal kar sakta hai
settings.consentHint: Inmein se koi bhi band karein aur Healix use turant istemaal karna band kar deta hai.
settings.consentFailed: Yeh badlav save nahi ho paya. Kripya phir koshish karein.
settings.privacyBody: Aapki health jaankari server par rehti hai, is browser mein kabhi nahi. Is device par sirf aapki bhasha aur bade akshar ki pasand yaad rakhi jaati hai.

profileForm.myDetailsHint: Healix inse salaah ko aapke hisaab se dhalta hai. Aap inhein Settings mein kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.
profileForm.familyHint: Jiski aap dekhbhal karte hain use jodein. Har vyakti ki apni reports, tokens aur bookings hoti hain.
profileForm.name: Poora naam
profileForm.conditionsHint: Jo lagu hon unpar nishan lagayein. Koi na ho to khali chhodein.
profileForm.failed: Yeh save nahi ho paya. Kripya phir koshish karein.
profileForm.barLabel: Aap kiski dekhbhal sambhal rahe hain

community.title: Community
community.intro: Usi condition ke saath jee rahe logon ke anubhav padhein aur share karein. Aap ek upnaam se dikhte hain.
community.guidelines: Community ke sadasya doctor nahi hain. Kripya phone number, link ya dawai ki matra share na karein. Gambhir lakshanon mein 102 ya 112 par call karein.
community.emptyHint: Kuch upyogi share karne wale pehle vyakti bane.
community.error: Abhi community load nahi ho payi.
community.noReplies: Abhi koi jawab nahi. Madad karne wale pehle bane.
community.replyPlaceholder: Apna anubhav ya koi achhi baat likhein…
community.reported: Dhanyavaad. Hum is post ki samiksha karenge.
community.postTitlePlaceholder: Aap kya share karna ya poochhna chahte hain?
community.postBodyPlaceholder: Kuch panktiyon mein apni baat ya sawaal likhein.
community.titleShort: Kripya kam se kam 4 akshar ka sheershak likhein.
community.bodyShort: Kripya kam se kam 10 akshar likhein.

problem.phone: Sabki privacy ke liye kripya phone number hatayein.
problem.email: Sabki privacy ke liye kripya email address hatayein.
problem.dose: Kripya dawai ki matra hatayein. Uske liye apne doctor ya pharmacist se poochhein.

community.slowDown: Aap bahut jaldi post kar rahe hain. Kripya thoda rukein.
community.sessionExpired: Aapka session khatam ho gaya hai. Post karne ke liye kripya phir sign in karein.
community.offline: Server tak nahi pahunch pa rahe. Apna connection check karein aur phir koshish karein.
community.failed: Yeh post nahi ho payi. Kripya phir koshish karein.

tokenView.sampleNote: Aapka token aisa dikhega. Apna token paane ke liye doctor book karein.

booked.title: Token book
booked.body: Queue mein aapki jagah surakshit hai.

queue.title: Apni baari ka intezaar
queue.body: Aap ghar par intezaar kar sakte hain. Healix batayega kab nikalna hai.

turn.title: Andar bulaya gaya
turn.body: Token par dikhaye gaye kamre mein jaayein.

done.title: Visit poori
done.body: Agli baar aapki reports aur sawaal saath ja sakte hain.
